rooms.note: The passage is a straight line of eight rooms, 36 to 43, then 44: each has one way back on the left and one way on to the right, nothing else. Details (chain, painted Km. signs, grate, cobwebs) are from the screenshot and help a player tell the stretches apart.

The poster says the passage to the towers is closed for repairs and to use the main entrance. The only way out is on the left, and it comes out back in the torch room.
